releaseCenter.title: Release Center
releaseCenter.subtitle: Registering a release does not activate it: builds, OTA updates and installers are registered as release facts first, and clients only update after an admin activates a policy.

terminalDesc.mobile: Staff and store manager app. Native builds and OTA roll out on separate lanes; OTA is split into production and preview.
terminalDesc.ipad: iPad POS. App Store native builds plus EAS OTA.
terminalDesc.handheld: Handheld POS. OTA covers production only and decisions are sent after device authentication.
terminalDesc.wpf: Windows POS client. Installers are uploaded from the web and can target stores or devices.

releaseCenter.readOnly: This account is read-only: policies, uploads and rollouts cannot be changed.
releaseCenter.matrixHint: Each cell is the active policy of one lane (production for OTA). Click to manage the lane.
releaseCenter.loadFailedHint: Some lanes failed to load. Refresh to retry; you can still open each client.
releaseCenter.attentionHint: Release decisions waiting for an admin. Click to open the lane.

attention.pendingRelease: {{count}} newer release(s) not rolled out, latest {{latest}}
attention.pendingReleaseDesc: Registered, but the policy still targets an older release. Activate it in the lane when ready.
attention.bindingInvalidDesc: Devices will reject the current binding. Choose a candidate again.
attention.partialRolloutDesc: Expand to everyone once it looks good.

releaseCenter.recentHint: Last policy save of each lane, newest first
